name: Summer RAD Camp
operator_name: UMaine Campus Recreation and the Town of Orono
description_short: Weekly day camp for kids in kindergarten to grade 5, based on the University of Maine campus in Orono. Each week has a theme, with swimming, climbing, sports, crafts, canoeing and trips around Orono and Bangor.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Ages 5 to 11 and grades K to 5 are stated. Extended care: drop off and pick up up to 1.5 hours before or after 9 to 4 at no extra charge. ZIP is the university's, from the page footer; camp uses three campus sites so no street is given.

source.title: Summer RAD Camps - Campus Recreation - University of Maine

warnings: The page states $210 per week for members and non-members, but the registration tab says registration this summer is $195 a week. Price left blank.
The page says ages 5 to 11, but its staff ratio note mentions ages 8 to 12.
Extended field trips for the oldest group are an add-on with an 8 am drop off and 5:30 pm pick up.
unknowns: street address of the home base sites

changes: Found the camp's own page at https://umaine.edu/campusrecreation/summer-camps/ (linked from https://umaine.edu/summercamps/sports-and-recreation/, which the listing tool read as naming no camp; it is an index of several programs).

Drafted only Summer RAD Camp. The index also lists Maine Summer Sports Camps (run by UMaine Athletics on another site) and 4-H shooting sports camps at Bryant Pond and Greenland Point, which are separate programs and already have their own drafts or listings.
Recorded the 2026 weeks; no 2027 dates are posted. The week list has no year, but it sits under a Summer 2026 dates tab and the weekdays match 2026.
Left price out because the page gives two weekly rates.
